purpose: Batch 3 four-slot facial reference provenance and capture-quality manifest.

basis.title: Understanding the face image format Standards
basis.adopted_rules: Full-face frontal pose; roll, pitch and yaw within approximately +/-5 degrees; neutral closed-mouth expression; eyes normally open; plain background; diffuse evenly distributed light.

basis.title: Illustrative Guidelines for Portraits in a Machine Readable Travel Document
basis.adopted_rules: Direct camera gaze; upright head and level eye line; both face edges visible; natural skin tone; sharp high-resolution image; uniform light without facial or background shadows.

project_rules.subject: One fictional adult woman; no real-person or public-figure input reference.
project_rules.camera: Eye-level full frontal capture, simulated 70 mm equivalent normal portrait perspective.
project_rules.visibility: Hairline, both ears, both jaw edges, full chin, neck and shoulder outline visible.
project_rules.appearance: Hair behind ears and away from face; minimal makeup; natural skin texture; plain gray crew-neck top.
reject_if: yaw, pitch or roll is visibly outside the frontal tolerance
jaw, chin, cheek edge, eyes or hairline is obscured
beauty filtering, face reshaping, contour makeup or skin smoothing is visible
wide-angle perspective, smile, open mouth, directional shadow or dramatic light is present
the visible geometry does not materially match the declared bone-structure role

provenance_policy.rights_note: Generated specifically for this repository without a third-party portrait input. This records provenance; it is not a legal opinion or a grant beyond the applicable service and repository terms.
